title: Agent Safehouse: Sandbox your LLM coding agents on macOS so they can only touch the files they need

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: If you're using AI coding agents, there's this reality where they can technically access your entire computer like SSH keys, API tokens, everything. Agent Safehouse locks them into just your project folder using Mac sandbox feature. One script, no Docker, no VMs. The AI can still code. It just can't accidentally wander into your sensitive files. It's basically a leash for your AI agent.
